note: Recorder only. No command publisher or enable from this tool.
claim_scope: Final ROS velocity command to reported wheel feedback on clear floor. Not executed wheel target, motor PI latency, independent body motion, slip, stopping certification, navigation, obstacle crossing or governor benefit. Missing target telemetry limits identification to the combined command-to-wheel path.

topics.name: /cmd_vel
topics.purpose: Final velocity request visible on ROS. Twist has no header; bag time is recorder receipt, not STM32 receipt or actuator execution time.

topics.name: /motor_fb
topics.purpose: Original named left/right JointState position rad and velocity rad/s from STM32. Verify mapping, units, source clock and freshness. Effort remains reported_unverified, not independently measured torque or current.

topics.name: /motor_status
topics.purpose: Raw status bitmask with matching firmware schema. Freshness, bus-off and timeout support interpretation. Bit 4 is firmware g_system_enabled before RC arbitration; it is not effective_enable, physical motor power or measured torque.

topics.name: /imu/data
topics.purpose: Original IMU with sensor-frame values and source header. Supports gyro/acceleration inspection but alone does not give independent body speed.

topics.name: /cmd_vel_teleop
topics.purpose: Teleop source request if this source is active. Must be required in the run-specific profile when claiming source-to-final chain tracing.

topics.name: /cmd_vel_selected
topics.purpose: Arbitration output if active. Must be required in the run-specific profile when claiming this stage was traced.

topics.name: /cmd_vel_smoothed
topics.purpose: Shaped reference before collision monitor if active. Must be required in the run-specific profile when claiming this stage was traced; still not an executed wheel target.

topics.name: /motor_enable
topics.purpose: Explicit ROS enable/disable requests. Firmware status is not effective RC permission or motor power readback.

topics.name: /cmd_mit
topics.purpose: Observe conflicting or mode-changing MIT requests if present. Do not create or replay commands to populate this channel.

topics.name: /cmd_torque
topics.purpose: Observe conflicting or mode-changing torque requests if present. A command is not measured torque; do not create or replay it.

topics.name: /joint_states
topics.purpose: Bridge conversion for comparison with original /motor_fb. Not an additional independent wheel measurement.

topics.name: /imu/bridge
topics.purpose: Bridge IMU for comparison; header may be sanitized.

topics.name: /odom/unfiltered
topics.purpose: Encoder-derived odometry with declared geometry. Not independent body speed or slip ground truth.

topics.name: /scan_raw
topics.purpose: Horizontal LiDAR context if already running. No body-reference claim without a separately validated estimator, clock and uncertainty. Required context for this trial scene guard; not independent body truth.

topics.name: /tf
topics.purpose: Dynamic declared frame context if supplied; a full odom frame tree is not required for the command-to-wheel claim.

topics.name: /tf_static
topics.purpose: Declared sensor mounting context if supplied. Required context for this trial scene guard; not independent body truth.

topics.name: /odom
topics.purpose: Encoder/IMU EKF context, not independent body reference

topics.name: /collision_monitor_state
topics.purpose: Monitor action changes if published; sparse event channel
